thoughts.text: Confirm Halcyon invoice INV-2026-017 (£6,000) actually arrived; it was due 30 Oct and the check task is due 31 Oct.
thoughts.why_now: Due tomorrow (30 Oct) with a check task on 31 Oct, and it is the largest outstanding payment on the Kestrel work.

thoughts.text: The boiler replacement part is still not fitted and no return visit is booked, so the heating runs on a temporary bypass; the chase to Tom may duplicate the 28 Oct chase.
thoughts.why_now: Heating is only partly working, the landlord promised the part early next week, and the 30 Oct task may need no action beyond confirming a visit date.

thoughts.text: Colour-token accessibility audit is due Mon 2 Nov and the final Kestrel prototype review is Tue 3 Nov at 14:00 at Halcyon Labs.
thoughts.why_now: Both fall within the next five days and the audit is needed before the prototype review.

thoughts.text: Ivy's Harbour Museum permission slip and the £12 ParentPay payment are due Tue 3 Nov and still open.
thoughts.why_now: Due within days, and the school trip on 10 Nov depends on it.

thoughts.text: The 2025-26 tax file needs the P60 found by Sun 8 Nov and the P60, expenses and pension statements sent to Rhea Kapoor by Sun 15 Nov; Rhea's estimate will need updating once they arrive.
thoughts.why_now: The first deadline is 8 Nov, about ten days away, and the P60 location is not confirmed.

thoughts.text: A fake Northmoor Bank security email from 26 Oct asks for account verification within 24 hours; treat it as phishing and do not act on it.
thoughts.why_now: It is the latest in a run of scam messages, and a similar bank-verification request could arrive again.

thoughts.text: The Brightway car insurance renewal on 14 Nov is at a revised £548, but an older £612 quote shows the old address, so confirm the live policy shows Flat 3 and the new premium.
thoughts.why_now: The renewal is about two weeks away, and the task record is inconsistent (dated 7 Nov but marked done on 20 Oct).

thoughts.text: Ceramics deadlines are close: the £45 Harbourside stall fee is due 6 Nov and the two late-November kiln firings with Lena must be booked by 10 Nov.
thoughts.why_now: The stall is confirmed for 12-13 Dec, and the kiln slots matter before Christmas demand fills the kiln.

bridges.why: The phishing email impersonates Northmoor Bank, which holds the business account ending 4471 whose statements and admin are tracked under the banking topic.
Grace's notes give the move-in date as 1 Sept while the Alder Street tenancy notes say 15 Sep, so the family and housing records disagree on when the move happened.
The car insurance policy address is changing to Flat 3, 22 Alder Street, so the move and the insurance renewal are linked and the older quote's old address needs correcting.
